title: improve_lazy_import_error_message
request: When accessing a missing attribute from lazy import modules like langfuse.api.observations or langfuse.api.media, I want the AttributeError to list the available attributes instead of the generic message.
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_lazy_import_error_message.py
@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+import pytest
+
+def test_observations_missing_attribute_error_message():
+    from langfuse.api import observations
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError) as excinfo:
+        getattr(observations, "NonExistentAttr")
+    msg = str(excinfo.value)
+    assert "NonExistentAttr" in msg
+    # should list at least one known attribute
+    assert "ObservationsV2Meta" in msg
+    assert "Available" in msg
+
+def test_media_missing_attribute_error_message():
+    from langfuse.api import media
+    with pytest.raises(AttributeError) as excinfo:
+        getattr(media, "FakeAttr")
+    msg = str(excinfo.value)
+    assert "FakeAttr" in msg
+    # ensure a known attribute from the media module is mentioned
+    assert "GetMediaResponse" in msg
+    assert "Available" in msg
